provenance.cv_protocol: StratifiedGroupKFold over functions on group_id, 10 folds x 5 repeats; AUC per run, averaged
provenance.hyperparameters: n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=2, class_weight=balanced_subsample, fixed a priori (no tuning)
provenance.caveat: labels are the per-run outcomes of 3 runs of one pipeline configuration; this model predicts what THIS pipeline fails at, not translatability
